sources.title: A Leader's Framework for Decision Making
claims: Decision context must be classified before selecting a response mode.
Complex contexts require probe-sense-respond and safe-to-fail experiments.
Chaotic contexts require act-sense-respond to establish sufficient order before learning.

sources.title: Leverage Points: Places to Intervene in a System
claims: Parameter changes are usually lower leverage than information flows, rules, goals, paradigms, and paradigm transcendence.
Delays relative to change rates generate oscillation and overshoot.
A system's actual goal is inferred from behavior, not its stated intent.

sources.title: Systems Archetypes I: Diagnosing Systemic Issues and Designing High-Leverage Interventions
claims: Move from event symptoms through behavior-over-time patterns to systemic structure.
Archetypes are recurring structures used to diagnose long-term dynamics and identify intervention hypotheses.
Causal-loop and behavior-over-time diagrams should be paired before causal claims are promoted.

invariants: Every doctrine-backed decision mode names at least one source id in this registry.
Every source hash is SHA-256 of the retrieved source bytes, not an LLM-generated summary.
A source record supports a hypothesis; it does not authorize an external intervention.
